description: Drive-canon geography synchronization overlay for Wire to Wire. This file records the current geography/travel state from the authoritative WTW working registry and supersedes conflicting values in older geography staging files until those files are regenerated.

authority.source: WTW CANON REGISTRIES — 1999 START v3.3 WORKING RECONCILIATION

boundary_cases.name: Delaware Park
boundary_cases.note: Official address is Wilmington; access/location commonly described at Stanton. Use Wilmington node until parcel boundary is finalized.

boundary_cases.name: Golden Gate Fields
boundary_cases.note: Property spans Albany and Berkeley; majority is in Albany. Use Albany as travel node pending parcel-level rule.

boundary_cases.name: Suffolk Downs
boundary_cases.note: Historic property spans East Boston and Revere. Clubhouse/track access anchor is East Boston; preserve both municipalities.

boundary_cases.name: Great Lakes Downs
boundary_cases.note: Racing authority used a Muskegon postal address; parcel evidence places site in Fruitport Township. Use Muskegon travel node pending normalization.

boundary_cases.name: Bainbridge Park
boundary_cases.note: Sources place track along Route 43 in Aurora and identify Bainbridge Township. Use Aurora travel node.

shipping_geography.method: Coarse planning bands derived from canonical city/locality travel nodes. Bands are intentionally conservative and are not surveyed road mileages. Current event windows are tested for horse-van feasibility, chronology, and absence of teleportation.

organization_geography.note: 20 organizations have at least region/state/county/city source geography; legacy farms still need municipality-level recovery.

trainer_participant_geography.note: 27 exact opening string locations joined to track geography; permanent home bases and birthplaces remain incomplete.

calendar_policy.pre_1973: Year-level historical timing may remain broad where exact dates are not authenticated.
calendar_policy.from_1973_forward: Target exact race date wherever available.
calendar_policy.travel_rule: Use exact post-1973 dates plus canonical geography nodes to reject impossible campaign sequences.

next_actions: Apply route-band QA to historical campaign sequences.
Recover source-backed participant birthplaces and permanent operating bases.
Recover exact municipalities for legacy farms/studs without inventing addresses.
Recover foaling state/city/farm only where source-backed.
Keep five boundary cases dual-named unless parcel precision materially changes travel logic.
